parent_objective: export stratified four-wheel source corpus from M1271 accepted rows
blocked_by: M1272 admits source-corpus export before actor/Gym integration
supersedes: direct use of all 108 M1271 accepted rows as an unfiltered training/evaluation corpus

public_gates: M1273 must preserve actor input contract
M1273 must not use private holdout
M1273 must export all accepted rows and stratified boundary/high-regret/family-balanced subsets
M1273 must log inactive fault families separately
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add per-wheel/fault labels to actor inputs
do not count horizon-only rows as success
do not treat source-corpus rows as driver performance
do not claim high-fidelity validation from the compact pilot

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns M1271 accepted source-positive rows into a stratified reusable source corpus with boundary and family-balance metadata
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: source-corpus infrastructure only; no training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, recurrent-belief, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if export changes accepted-source semantics
stop if export leaks per-wheel/fault labels into actor observations
stop if export cannot reproduce M1271 accepted row count
fallback_plan: if export is valid, audit whether corpus admits boundary retargeting or intervention design
if export is invalid, repair corpus extraction before any further source work
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1272 admits stratified source corpus export

admission_evidence: M1272 near_boundary count at margin <=0.20 is 19
M1272 high_regret count at min cross-regret >=0.05 is 32
M1272 halfshaft rows are action-equivalent under current lattice
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1273 exports source rows only and does not test actor history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: future actor history tests remain blocked until source corpus is audited and routed to an intervention design
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If export shows source collapse or invalid row accounting, route to source-corpus audit rather than actor training.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: A stratified export can preserve M1271 accepted source rows while separating boundary-useful rows, high-regret rows, family-balanced rows, and inactive fault families.
success_criteria: no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: accepted row count does not match M1271
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1273 passes as infrastructure if it exports M1271 accepted rows into stratified source-corpus artifacts without training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion.
